title: Post-M1 exact-artifact GitHub Pages publication
purpose: Expose the exact promoted Learn-it M1 HTML artifact through one stable GitHub Pages URL without changing product semantics or adding any runtime service dependency.
invariants: The Pages workflow checks out the exact promoted M1 product merge rather than moving main product semantics.
The canonical deterministic build must reproduce exactly 334194 bytes and the frozen SHA-256 before publication.
Published index.html and downloadable learnit-next.html are byte-identical copies of the verified artifact.
No backend, runtime API, LLM, account, synchronization, remote catalog or service worker is introduced.
No persistent hand-maintained gh-pages product fork is created.
A future product release must explicitly update the pinned promotion identity before Pages can publish different bytes.
requiredEvidence: PR diff contains exactly this canonical work-package record and the Pages workflow.
Deployment build proves exact artifact SHA-256 and byte length before upload.
GitHub Pages returns a deployment URL and deployment evidence identifies the promoted head and digest.
adversarialTests: Reject deployment if checkout HEAD differs from the pinned promoted product merge.
Reject deployment if the deterministic build SHA-256 differs from the accepted M1 artifact digest.
Reject deployment if the deterministic build byte length differs from the accepted M1 artifact length.
Reject any implementation delta outside the Pages workflow and canonical work-package record.
Verify index.html and learnit-next.html are byte-identical before upload.
Verify no service worker, backend or runtime API dependency is added by the hosting layer.
independentReview: Repository governance validates the canonical package structure and repository invariants.
PR scope independently checks that the implementation remains inside the exact ATLAS-WP-002 allowlist.
The existing M1 exact-head CI router is not extended for this post-M1 distribution package and its branch-routing rejection is classified as not applicable.
The deployment itself must fail closed on promotion-head, artifact digest or artifact length drift.
nonGoals: Automatic publication of future product heads
rollback: Disable or remove the Pages workflow and Pages deployment. The promoted M1 product, learner state and downloadable canonical artifact remain unchanged.
